help_setolympiad: /setolympiad <MM-DD-YYYY> <MM-DD-YYYY> — open the Olympiad and its voting period (bot admins)
help_setcontest: /setcontest — create a contest of the Olympiad (bot admins)
help_editcontest: /editcontest — manage a contest's candidate wikis (bot admins)
help_olympiad: /olympiad — vote in the Olympiad (private chat with the bot only)
help_accepted: /accepted <key> <wiki username> [remember] — accept a vote under review
not_active: There is no Olympiad running right now.
dm_only: This command only works in a private chat with the bot.
setolympiad_usage: Usage: /setolympiad MM-DD-YYYY MM-DD-YYYY — the first and the last day of voting (UTC). /setolympiad off cancels the Olympiad and deletes its data.
setolympiad_bad_date: The dates must look like MM-DD-YYYY.
setolympiad_bad_order: The last day of voting cannot come before the first one.
setolympiad_set:
🏆 The Olympiad is open. Voting runs from {start} to {end} (UTC, the closing day included).
Its commands are being registered — Discord can take up to an hour to show them to everyone.
setolympiad_updated: 🏆 The Olympiad now runs from {start} to {end} (UTC, the closing day included).
setolympiad_off: The Olympiad is cancelled. Its contests, candidates and votes have been deleted.
setolympiad_off_none: There is no Olympiad to cancel.
setcontest_ask_lang: What language is the contest in? Send one of: {langs} — or int for a cross-language contest.
setcontest_ask_names_int: What is the contest called in each language? Send the names in one message, separated by commas, in this order: {order}.
setcontest_bad_names: Send exactly {count} names separated by commas, in this order: {order}.
setcontest_ask_review: Send the ID of the Discord chat the votes will go to for review.
setcontest_ask_approved: Send the ID of the Discord chat the accepted votes will go to.
setcontest_bad_chat: That is not a Discord chat ID. Send the number on its own.
setcontest_created: ✅ Contest created: {name}. Add its candidate wikis with /editcontest.
editcontest_none: There are no contests yet. Create one with /setcontest.
editcontest_choose: Which contest do you want to manage?
editcontest_no_candidates: {name} has no candidates yet. Send 1 to add one.
cand_ask_name: What is the wiki project called?
cand_bad_url: That is not a link. Send the wiki's address.
cand_ask_lang: What is its language code? One of: {langs}.
cand_menu: What do you want to do with {name}?
ask_lang: Hello! Which language should I speak with you in this chat? Pick one below.
lang_chosen: Done, I will write to you in English here.
ask_account_known: I already know your Fandom account: {name}.
ask_account_other: Send a link to your profile on any wiki host where your {platform} username is shown in the profile.
ask_activity: Now name or link a wiki project of the Confederations or of an Olympiad participant where you have more than 50 edits or messages. This speeds up the review of your vote.
choose_contest: Which contest do you want to vote in?
no_contests: There is nothing to vote for yet.
choose_candidates: Which wikis do you support? Reply with up to {max} numbers in one message.
candidates_invalid: Reply with up to {max} numbers from the list.
replacing_vote: You have already voted in {name}. A new vote replaces the old one and goes for review again.
ask_vote: Write out your vote, or press the button to give each of the wikis you chose one point.
vote_one_point_body: One point to each of the chosen wikis.
vote_sent: ✅ Your vote has been sent for review. Its key is {key}.
vote_replaced: ✅ Your new vote has been sent for review. Its key is {key}.
vote_no_channel: Your vote could not be delivered: the contest's review chat is unreachable. Please tell the bot's administrators.
voting_not_started: Voting has not started yet. It opens on {start} (UTC).
accepted_not_found: There is no vote with the key {key}.
accepted_wrong_chat: This vote is reviewed in another chat.
accepted_no_channel: The chat for accepted votes is unreachable.
accepted_remembered: The account {name} is now linked to this user.
accepted_dm_body: Your vote in {contest} for {wikis} has been accepted.
denied_not_found: There is no vote with the key {key}.
denied_dm_body:
Your vote in {contest} for {wikis} was not accepted.

Reason: {reason}
